latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Bulletproof Memory—Write-Ahead Log (WAL) protocol for persistent agent context.

- Introduces a trigger-based WAL protocol for stateful agent memory using SESSION-STATE.md.
- Ensures agents write key details to disk immediately on user input, surviving compaction and session restarts.
- Provides recovery, session startup, and memory flush protocols for automated context management.
- Includes setup guides, example files, and best practices for robust, never-lost context.
- Designed to integrate with PARA Second Brain and Proactive Agent for a complete memory stack.
